messages:
alex_c: thinking through the console flow for multi-variant experiments — need input on defaults for seeding, qps caps, and fallback routing.
maria_p: quick q — are we doing weight as float (0.0-1.0) or percent? UX and API should match.
sam_t: prefer percent in UI, float in backend. keep both but canonicalize to integer pct on save. smaller room for confusion.
priya_k: also we need a per-variant soft QPS cap so we can protect smaller models during ramp. proposal: "soft_qps" + hard fallback to heavier variant.
alex_c: +1 to soft_qps. thinking defaults: seed 0.01 (1%) for canary, auto-increase ramp rules, and max soft_qps = 100 for paid tiers. thoughts?
maria_p: default seed 1% sounds right. but console should warn if total seeds across variants > 10% for a new experiment. avoid traffic loss.
sam_t: telemetry: ensure every request has experiment_id and variant_id in tracing attrs. we should also emit per-variant token and latency counters. product wants per-variant cost estimates in the console.
priya_k: agree. also need a guard that blocks experiment creation if variant routes reference unavailable model flavors (quantized vs fp16) — check model compatibility at save time.
alex_c: good call. here's a draft of the routing rule payload for the API we discussed:
```
{
  "experiment_id": "auto-gen",
  "variants": [
    {"id": "v1", "weight_pct": 95, "soft_qps": 1000},
    {"id": "v2", "weight_pct": 5,  "soft_qps": 50}
  ],
  "fallback_policy": "route-to-v1-on-cap-exceed",
  "seeding": {"initial_pct": 1}
}
```
priya_k: fallback_policy needs to be richer. what about model-unavailable vs qps-exceed vs region-unavailable. we need typed reasons.
maria_p: UX: show a compact summary card in the console: total traffic, seeded pct, per-variant qps, compatibility checks (green/yellow/red). inline edit for weights.
sam_t: API detail: should the console call POST /api/console/experiments or the same /v1/experiments as infra? prefer console-specific endpoint that validates and returns warnings without creating infra resources.
alex_c: agreed — console endpoint for preflight validation then create via /v1 if passes. console endpoint should return warnings array and a list of compatibility_breakers.
console-bot: Preflight validation: model_compatibility: OK, total_weight: 100, seeded_pct: 1, warnings: ["v2 soft_qps is low vs expected latency"].
deploy-bot: FYI: automated rollout jobs will enforce per-variant QPS caps and emit events to #incidents if fallback triggers.
priya_k: one more: telemetry tags must include "experiment_name" human-readable for dashboard filters. not just id.
maria_p: UX question — allow drag-to-adjust weight graph across time? e.g., set weight schedule for next 24h -> show projected traffic and cost.
alex_c: that's the ideal. backend needs time-series ramping rules (start_pct, end_pct, start_ts, end_ts). keep API simple: accept ramps array.
sam_t: I'll start a PR for the console preflight API and add the validation checks (weights, model compatibility, seeding thresholds, qps caps).
alex_c: awesome — can you include unit tests for telemetry tagging? want to make sure no gaps.
sam_t: yup. will ping when draft is ready.
priya_k: tagging follow-up: also add eval_set reference in the experiment so we can tie quality regressions to specific variant.
maria_p: thanks all. feels like we have enough to prototype the UI card + preflight. I'll mock the summary and share tomorrow. :thumbsup:
